owner_decision: Option A approved on 2026-07-19. C2I-v2 kind 8 represents general symbol values; kind 5 remains exclusive to compiler-proven cross-container export-call edges.
finding: The six current manifests contain 979 general SYMBOL literal nodes. Literal spelling alone cannot prove that a value is a cross-container callable edge, so encoding every SYMBOL as the approved C2I export-name kind would invent semantics.
claim_limit: Read-only semantic census and format comparison. It changes no product byte, authorizes no capacity and does not alter the approved recursive-literal lowering.

options.summary: Add kind 8 general-symbol-name-offset while retaining kind 5 exclusively for a compiler-proven cross-container export edge. Both reuse the binary-safe local string pool; the mutable resolver interns kind 8 without claiming a function binding.
options.emitter_rule: Every legacy SYMBOL node maps to kind 8. Kind 5 is emitted only when compiler provenance identifies a cross-container callable edge and the target is a declared export. Name equality alone is never provenance.

options.summary: Generalize the existing export-name kind to every symbol. This costs no record bytes but erases the format-level distinction that makes cross-container callable edges auditable.

Classify a symbol as local/native/export because its spelling matches a function. The same literal representation is also used for quoted data and compiler opcode tables, so spelling does not prove use.

required_negative_fixtures: general-symbol name contains NUL, reader whitespace or non-ASCII bytes
general-symbol offset is not a string-record boundary
kind 8 carries a nonzero flags or reserved byte
kind 8 argument0 differs from the referenced record length
kind 5 export edge names an undeclared export
emitter attempts to derive kind 5 solely from spelling
consumer_rule: Tree-shaking, who-calls, ide-help cross-references and every future call-graph consumer may treat only kind 5 as call evidence. Kind 8 is invisible to call graphs and may never be upgraded from spelling alone.
decision: C2I-v2 kind 8 for general symbol values is approved. Kind 5 remains reserved for proven export edges; the two alternatives remain rejected.
